Subject: Acme Health Tech - Next steps & technical deep dive scheduling

Hi Jordan and Lisa -

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

What we covered:
- High-level goals: reduce inference latency for real-time triage, get costs under $0.03 per 1k tokens for batch inference, and ensure PHI handling meets your compliance bar.
- Current infra: 2x A100 clusters, bespoke caching layer, limited KV-cache reuse.
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency < 250ms for critical paths; end-to-end throughput targets for nightly batch jobs.

Proposed next step:
- 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra leads to align on integration approach, data flows, and a preliminary rollout plan. We recommend the following agenda (we'll attach a more detailed doc):
  1) Introductions & goals (5 min)
  2) Current infra and constraints (15-20 min) - Acme to present
  3) Redwood runtime + kernel selection + quantization options (20-25 min) - internal product/infra
  4) Caching/batching strategies and integration touchpoints (15-20 min)
  5) Security/compliance & private deployment considerations (10 min)
  6) Next steps: mutual action plan + timelines (5-10 min)

Availability: I pulled a few recommended times below (PDT):
- Tue 16 Jun: 10:00-11:30 or 14:00-15:30
- Wed 17 Jun: 09:30-11:00 or 13:00-14:30
- Thu 18 Jun: 11:00-12:30

Please let us know which slot works best and who from your ML/infra/security teams will join. Camila and Dev are copied and will lead the technical portion from our side.

Attachments: redwood_ma_summary.pdf (short one-pager), technical-deep-dive-agenda.docx (detailed agenda)

Thanks - looking forward to continuing the conversation.

-
Marissa Cole
